run_grasp_pipeline: run the polygrasp bin-picking pipeline that connects to a robot, cameras, and grasp server to execute grasps
execute_grasp: execute a grasp on the robot by moving to the grasp pose, lifting, shifting horizontally, and releasing
merge_pcds: merge object point clouds from multiple cameras by clustering centroids using DBSCAN
save_rgbd_masked: save side-by-side plots of original and masked RGBD images from multiple cameras to a PNG file
main: run the main polygrasp loop that segments objects, selects grasps, and executes them on a robot
